evidence.reason: Removed metering.initialize() and changed plan from "monthly" to "benchmark" while passing undefined as multiplier, altering the computed charge.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, so callers relying on the default now compute a different (potentially zero) charge.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate/usageQuote with 0.1 multiplier; the merged defaults may still pass but the semantics relied upon (non-zero default rate) are weakened.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动共同改变了订阅计费的默认乘数与初始化行为，可能使依赖默认费率的调用返回零或异常结果，证据不足以完全确认安全。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的 multiplier 默认值，恢复为 configuration.rate（或显式传入有效乘数），并确认 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 是否仍需调用 metering.initialize() 及使用 "monthly" 计划。
